sentences.text: This THIRD bail application has been filed by applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No. 233/2023 registered at Police Station Dabra Dehat District Gwalior (M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 304B, 498A and 34 of IPC.

sentences.text: His earlier applications M.Cr.C.No.45203 of 2023 and 55155 of 2023 were dismissed as withdrawn vide orders dated 17th October, 2023 and 12th January, 2024 respectively.
As per the case of prosecution, Muskan was married to Ishaq Ali on 5th November, 2022.
Muskan committed suicide by hanging on 14.7.2023.
Jumman Ali (father), Jamina Begum (mother), Shahid alias Karu (brother) of deceased alleged that Ishaq Ali, husband of Muskan was harassing her for demand of dowry.
Therefore, the Muskan had committed suicide due to constant harassment.
Applicant was arrested on 19.07.2023.
He is in custody ever since.

sentences.text: The trial is underway.

Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant is falsely implicated in this matter merely for the reason that he is husband of deceased.
Learned counsel referring to the statement of Jumman Ali (PW2), Jamina (PW3) and Shahid alias Karu (PW4) submits that near relatives of deceased Muskan have not supported the prosecution.
The fate of prosecution is apparent.
There is no likelihood of tampering with the remaining evidence by the applicant.
Applicant is a labourer by profession.
He has family to look after.
No criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving family and home.
Trial would take time to conclude.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
